mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, c.student_name AS studentName, o.name AS organization_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course(user_id, title, student_name, organization_id, subject, stage, course_type, start_time, end_time, fee, location, note, status, color, reminder_offset_minutes, repeat_type, repeat_end_date, parent_id, template_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{studentName}, #{organizationId}, #{subject}, #{stage}, #{courseType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{fee}, #{location}, #{note}, #{status}, #{color}, #{reminderOffsetMinutes}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatEndDate}, #{parentId}, #{templateId})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY start_time
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET template_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND template_id = #{templateId}
